basis: Supplied Health Check text-codes, supplied newer-form question structure, supplied Gut Reset PDF and supplied bioactive/mechanism registry material.
important_boundary: The outcome entities below are a proposed architecture. They are not presented as existing implemented outcomes unless the source explicitly establishes them.

proposed_outcomes.name: General Health & Resilience
source_basis: Existing Health Check result category: General health
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Broad wellbeing and resilience outcome when the user does not have a single dominant goal.
proposed_outcomes.notes: Keep broad enough to be useful, but do not allow it to become a dumping ground for every question.

proposed_outcomes.name: Energy & Vitality
source_basis: Gut Reset material: Energy levels soar
Existing result language concerning energy stability
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support a person's stated goal of having more energy and vitality.
proposed_outcomes.notes: Energy should be an explicit outcome, not simply a proxy for one body-system score.

proposed_outcomes.name: Sleep & Recovery
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support better sleep quality and recovery.
proposed_outcomes.notes: Sleep is sufficiently represented in the source material to warrant a dedicated outcome.

proposed_outcomes.name: Digestion & Gut Health
source_basis: Existing result category: Digestion / Weight Management
Gut Reset material: Digestion is improved
Existing Digestive and Intestinal system results
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support digestive comfort, regularity and gut/intestinal resilience.
proposed_outcomes.notes: Separate digestion from weight management in the new model even though the historical result category combined them.

proposed_outcomes.name: Healthy Weight & Metabolic Balance
source_basis: Existing result category: Digestion / Weight Management
Gut Reset material: Weight control is easier
Q17 cravings and Q24 dietary/cholesterol context
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support healthy weight-management behaviours and metabolic wellbeing.
proposed_outcomes.notes: Do not turn this into a diagnostic metabolic score.

proposed_outcomes.name: Mobility, Joints & Physical Function
source_basis: Existing result category: Mobility / Aches & Pains
Gut Reset material: Aches & pains reduce
FL-3X factsheet positioning around mobility, range of motion and flexibility
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support movement, mobility, comfort and physical function.
proposed_outcomes.notes: This should distinguish joint and muscle constructs rather than treating all aches and pains as one signal.

proposed_outcomes.name: Circulation & Cardiovascular Fitness
source_basis: Current bioactive evidence containing vascular/circulatory mechanisms
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support healthy circulation and cardiovascular fitness.
proposed_outcomes.notes: Keep lifestyle-support framing and avoid diagnosing cardiovascular disease.

proposed_outcomes.name: Sports Performance & Physical Capacity
source_basis: Current bioactive registry includes creatine with muscle/brain energy and performance keywords
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support exercise capacity, training, recovery and performance.
proposed_outcomes.notes: This is a distinct goal from general mobility. Someone can have good mobility but want better performance.

proposed_outcomes.name: Mood, Stress & Emotional Balance
source_basis: Gut Reset material: Happiness goes up
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support healthy stress management, emotional balance and recovery.
proposed_outcomes.notes: Use neutral, non-diagnostic language. This is a wellbeing outcome, not a mental-health diagnosis.

proposed_outcomes.name: Immune Resilience
source_basis: Gut Reset material: Immunity is boosted
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support normal resilience and recovery from everyday health challenges.
proposed_outcomes.notes: Use 'resilience' rather than implying the questionnaire measures immune competence or deficiency.

proposed_outcomes.name: Hormonal & Life-Stage Balance
source_basis: Q47 menstruation issues and Q48 menopausal concerns in text-codes
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Provide appropriate lifestyle context for hormonal and life-stage concerns.
proposed_outcomes.notes: This must be conditional and must not imply measurement of hormone levels.

proposed_outcomes.name: Healthy Ageing & Cellular Resilience
source_basis: Gut Reset material: You look more youthful
Current bioactive registry includes healthy-ageing/cellular-resilience terminology
proposed_outcomes.purpose: Support long-term healthy ageing and cellular resilience as a broad wellbeing goal.
proposed_outcomes.notes: This is a candidate outcome and needs stronger definition before it is allowed to drive recommendations.

architecture.purpose: Who the person is and relevant context
architecture.description: Age, sex/gender context where appropriate, dietary profile and other non-scored context.

architecture.purpose: What the person wants help with
architecture.description: One or more selected outcomes. These drive prioritisation.
Symptoms, behaviours, exposures and observations, each tagged by construct.
The nine historical domains, modernised but retained for continuity.
Sleep, stress, energy, activity, nutrition, recovery and other legitimate cross-domain constructs.

architecture.purpose: What must not be recommended blindly
architecture.description: Medical treatment, allergies, sensitivities and other safety/context fields.
Bioactives, mechanisms, foods and products with evidence/confidence metadata.
Ranked recommendations based on selected outcomes, signals, constraints and evidence.

next_step: Use this outcome layer to remap all questionnaire questions before finalising wording or score formulas.
